content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-97 (bundled into another paid service), which is a coding/bundling issue, not a medical-necessity issue—so the prior necessity appeal didn't address it. Retro-auth is irrelevant (auth not required), and P2P addresses clinical necessity rather than bundling edits. The correct fix is to add an appropriate unbundling modifier to show the service is separately payable and resubmit; this isn't a duplicate since the claim was denied, not paid.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
